findings.deepseek_medium: The merged PR18 summary includes 402 Insufficient Balance trials as losses; they are excluded here.
findings.format_only_protocol: Historical prompt code before 412ba5f did not branch on HARD_FORMAT_ONLY, so accepted raw runs received MECHANICS_HARD. The paper-intended action-protocol-retaining prompt was added later.
findings.gpt_main_cells: N=5 per effort; the paper-facing N=10 was a none+medium pool, not N=10 per effort.
findings.gpt_norules: Raw validity must be read from candidate trials; all-credit/API failures are excluded.

validity_rule.excluded: infrastructure, authentication, timeout, parse, environment, incomplete, or duplicate trial
validity_rule.model_invalid_action: kept as model behavior when the API response was received and the trial otherwise completed
validity_rule.post_run_understanding_error: does not invalidate the already completed game outcome
